purpose: Equipment and services procurement packages for Industry 4.0 smart manufacturing implementation. Each package includes criticality, vendor qualification criteria, technical documents, inspection requirements, and acceptance tests.

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: IEC 62443-4-2 conformance; proven OPC UA/MQTT support; local support availability; backward compatibility with existing PLC protocols (Modbus, Profinet, EtherNet/IP)
technical_documents_required: Edge node OS requirements and inference workload profile
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise: factory functional test with protocol bridging validation; thermal chamber test for environmental rating verification
packages.acceptance_tests: 72-hour sustained operation at site conditions with all protocols active and data flowing to historian

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Benchmarked inference latency for target vision/PdM models; industrial form factor; GPU compute meets target model concurrency with 30% headroom
technical_documents_required: Storage buffer sizing for expected connectivity gaps
packages.inspection_requirements: FAT with benchmark models at expected concurrency; thermal validation at worst-case cabinet temperature
packages.acceptance_tests: Inference latency within budget at full concurrency; buffer integrity during 1-hour connectivity gap test

packages.package_name: IIoT Sensor Suite (Vibration, Temperature, Current, Environmental)
packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Accuracy/range matching PdM use cases; connectivity (IO-Link, 4-20 mA, Modbus, wireless) compatible with edge gateways; environmental rating for installation zone
technical_documents_required: Sensor data sheets with accuracy/range specs
packages.inspection_requirements: Sample batch calibration verification against reference instruments
packages.acceptance_tests: Inline calibration check post-installation; data quality comparison against baseline instrumentation over 7-day period

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Resolution and frame rate sufficient for smallest defect at line speed; SDK/API supports ML pipeline integration; lighting/optics validated for defect type
technical_documents_required: Line speed and cycle time requirements
packages.inspection_requirements: FAT: defect detection rate validated against reference defect set at required line speed
packages.acceptance_tests: SAT: 8-hour production run at nameplate line speed; detection accuracy within agreed tolerance

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Native OPC UA and MQTT/Sparkplug B connectors; open APIs for downstream consumers; scalable to full-plant tag volumes with predictable licensing; non-punitive per-tag pricing curve
packages.inspection_requirements: Proof-of-concept: 7-day data ingestion from representative edge nodes at full-scale tag rates
packages.acceptance_tests: Sustained ingestion of full expected tag count at < 5 s end-to-end latency; export of 30-day dataset within SLA

packages.package_name: Data Lake & Analytics Platform (Cloud or On-Premise)
packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Standard formats (Parquet, Avro, Delta/Iceberg) for data interoperability; ML pipeline integration; IT/OT governance support
technical_documents_required: Cost model at full scale (ingest, store, compute, egress)
packages.inspection_requirements: Validate data model against ISA-95 information model; review security and access controls
packages.acceptance_tests: End-to-end pipeline: edge → historian → lake → dashboard; data quality metrics within tolerance

packages.package_name: OT Network & Security Appliances (Firewalls, Switches, DMZ)
packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: IEC 62443-4-2 conformance for OT-rated switches and firewalls; deep packet inspection for industrial protocols; throughput meets peak traffic with inspection enabled
packages.inspection_requirements: FAT: validation of zone segmentation rules and firewall policy enforcement in test rig
packages.acceptance_tests: SAT: pen test confirms deny-by-default segmentation; no OT-IT cross-zone traffic without explicit conduit rules

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Proven Industry 4.0 and OT delivery experience; IEC 62443 credentials; references from comparable manufacturing engagements; knowledge transfer and post-go-live support commitment
technical_documents_required: Detailed SOW with deliverables and acceptance criteria
Staffing plan and key personnel CVs
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-payment gates tied to verified milestones (architecture sign-off, connectivity test, UAT pass, operations handover)
packages.acceptance_tests: UAT sign-off by plant operations team; all deliverables accepted per SOW; knowledge transfer sessions completed

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Proven connectors to the specific MES/QMS/WMS instances at site; support for ISA-95 data model mapping; open APIs for data platform integration
technical_documents_required: Interface control documents for each system
Data model mapping (ISA-95 to system schema)
packages.inspection_requirements: FAT: data flow validation between each system and the data platform in a staging environment
packages.acceptance_tests: SAT: 7-day continuous data flow validation; all expected data points flowing without gaps; error handling verified

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Support for reproducible training, model registry, CI/CD for ML, and production monitoring; edge deployment capability for vision/PdM models
technical_documents_required: Model deployment pipeline (training → registry → edge → monitoring)
packages.inspection_requirements: Proof-of-concept: deploy one vision and one PdM model through the full pipeline; validate monitoring and drift detection
packages.acceptance_tests: Full MLOps pipeline validated with representative models; model rollback tested; drift detection operational

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: PTP grandmaster clock (IEEE 1588) with GPS/GNSS reference; NTP server for IT zone; accuracy within target microseconds; supports mixed hardwired/wireless topology
technical_documents_required: Accuracy specs at expected hop count
packages.acceptance_tests: Post-installation accuracy measurement across all time-sensitive devices within target tolerance
